text:
Sam C: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw the cross-region egress retry pattern again this morning around ~2026-03-20 02:10 UTC. Need remediation owners, short timelines, and confirmation that route-selection shadowing isn't re-introducing flaps. cc @Maya R @Chris L @Lia P

Maya R: I'll dig into infra metrics. Were the retries TLS-only or combined with connection errors?

Chris L: From a quick scan it's TLS handshake timeouts that precede retries. Appears to correlate with route flips between region-a and region-b. :thinking:

Lia P: Pasting a short edge-proxy log snippet around the spike:
```
Mar 20 02:09:58 proxy edge-proxy[2345]: TLS handshake timeout for conn id=0x7f8... dest=region-b-lb:443 err=handshake timeout
Mar 20 02:10:02 proxy edge-proxy[2345]: retrying request id=abc123 attempt=2 route=region-a -> region-b
```

Chris L: That aligns with a certificate rotate event we had earlier, but cert chain looked fine. Another hypothesis: conntrack exhaustion delaying TCP allocations and slowing handshake. @Maya R can you check conntrack counts for that timeframe?

Maya R: Running a quick check now: `kubectl exec -n infra-bastion conntrack-scan -- /sbin/conntrack -S | grep entries`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shadow route-weighting applied to canary in region-a at 2026-03-20T02:05Z (sha abcde).

Sam C: :eyes: Proposed action list (short):
1) Confirm conntrack thresholds were hit and which nodes (owner: Maya R, due: 2026-03-21)
2) Add route-weighting to the shadow config and roll gradually (owner: Chris L, due: 2026-03-22)
3) Run a 48h synthetic cross-region e2e that mirrors the spike profile (owner: Lia P, due: 2026-03-25)
4) Update the postmortem follow-up doc with timelines and escalate if SLO impact persists (owner: Sam C, due: 2026-03-23)

Lia P: I'll kick off the e2e using the previous traffic profile + a 2x spike. Job: <https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/jobs/482>. Will post failure traces if we see >1% retry rate.

Maya R: Quick conntrack peek: entries=198k, max=200k on node-efg-1. We hit ~199.8k around 02:09 UTC. That's consistent with delayed TCP allocations and handshake timeouts. :grimacing:

Chris L: Ok — short term options: bump conntrack thresholds on nodes + restart affected podset, OR implement connection pooling at the edge-proxy to reduce churn. I'll draft a route-weighting PR (so we don't oscillate). Long-term: connection pooling + improved backoff.

Sam C: Can we get concrete PRs and target dates? We want to reduce cross-region retry SLO impact to <1% over the next week.

Maya R: Opening infra PR to bump conntrack + a controlled node restart plan: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3345|infra#3345> — target merge 2026-03-21. Will include rollback steps.

Chris L: Route-weighting config PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/networking/pull/789|networking#789> — includes gradual weighting, metric gates (latency, retries), and a canary window. Target: 2026-03-22.

Lia P: E2E job 482 started. Initial run (first 6h) shows retry rate peaked at 0.8% during the synthetic spike. Continuing full 48h run now.

Sam C: Also, please verify TLS rotation automation logs — if rotation overlapped with conntrack pressure it could have amplified retries. Owner: Chris L to add an alert for cert diff during rotation.

Chris L: Will do. PR to add cert-rotation diff alert: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-alerting/pull/210|ops-alerting#210>.

Maya R: Short-term conntrack bump applied to canary nodes at 2026-03-20T04:00Z. Monitoring for regressions.

Lia P: After 6h post-bump the e2e shows retry rate down to 0.3% during the same spike window. Posting raw metrics to the follow-up doc.

Sam C: Great progress. Next check-in: tomorrow 12:00 UTC to verify PRs merged and e2e completes. If we see any SLO regressions before then, ping me directly. I'll consolidate the action items into the postmortem doc and flag execs if we miss the 1% target.

Maya R: FYI infra#3345 landed on 2026-03-21 08:12 UTC and rolled to canary. Monitoring looks stable.

Chris L: networking#789 merged 2026-03-22 14:20 UTC with metric gates. Weighting phasing completed without spike. ops-alerting#210 merged same day.

Lia P: E2E finished 48h: overall retry rate averaged 0.25% with no correlated SLO breaches. Uploaded artifacts here: <https://internal.docs/postmortems/egress-2026-03-20/artifacts>.

Sam C: :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after we confirm one full week of stable metrics. If anyone sees regression, reopen and ping me.
